name: led-matrix
title: LED Matrix
description: A bus or pharmacy dot-matrix sign: round LEDs behind smoked glass in an aluminium housing, in amber, red, green or white. Messages scroll right to left a dot at a time, or hold a page at a time, in turn, drawn from its own 5×7 bitmap font for Latin-1 and €. A canvas paints only when a dot changes, only on screen and in a visible tab; reduced motion pages instead of scrolling. A marquee live region with the message, a pause toggle, and setMessages, pause and resume for agents.

[data-slot=\"led-matrix\"].background-image: radial-gradient(circle at 0.55rem 0.55rem, var(--led-screw) 0 0.13rem, #0008 0.16rem, transparent 0.2rem), radial-gradient( circle at calc(100% - 0.55rem) 0.55rem, var(--led-screw) 0 0.13rem, #0008 0.16rem, transparent 0.2rem ), radial-gradient( circle at 0.55rem calc(100% - 0.55rem), var(--led-screw) 0 0.13rem, #0008 0.16rem, transparent 0.2rem ), radial-gradient( circle at calc(100% - 0.55rem) calc(100% - 0.55rem), var(--led-screw) 0 0.13rem, #0008 0.16rem, transparent 0.2rem ), linear-gradient(180deg, #2c2c30 0%, #18181a 45%, #101012 100%)

docs: `<LedMatrix label messages|defaultMessages onMessagesChange paused|defaultPaused onPausedChange color mode speed holdMs columns rows live controls labels>`. `mode="scroll"` (the default) runs each message across at `speed` dots per second, then the next; `mode="hold"` shows each for `holdMs`, split at words into pages that fit `columns`, and so does a scrolling sign under reduced motion. `rows` is the height in dots (9 by default); 14 or more doubles the glyphs. The font covers printable ASCII, Latin-1 (á, ñ, ç, ß, ¿) and €; an accented letter it lacks shows its base letter, anything else `?`. The root is a `marquee` named by `label` with the current message as text, `aria-live` off unless `live="polite"`. The pause toggle (`labels.pause`) is there because motion that starts by itself needs a way to stop; `controls={false}` hides it when the page pauses the sign some other way. The housing and board are the item's `css`, the same in every theme.
